findings.label: Screenshot spec runs in the default e2e suite
findings.detail: apps/web/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts matches the chromium project's testMatch (.*\.spec\.ts) in playwright.config.mts, so every `pnpm test:e2e` (including CI) rewrites the 10 tracked PNGs in docs/screenshots/phase5/.
findings.action: Gate it behind an env var (e.g. SCREENSHOTS=1 + test.skip) or a separate Playwright project with a `pnpm screenshots` script.

findings.label: E2E noise in submission screenshots
findings.detail: employee-dashboard.png shows seven 'E2E 1791…' task rows and admin-employees.png shows four 'e2e-…@demo.com' accounts left by earlier specs in the shared test DB.
findings.action: Before the final submission, re-capture against a freshly reset and seeded test DB, or run the screenshot spec first, so only seed and Northwind demo data appear.

findings.label: Approval actions off-screen on mobile
findings.detail: In mobile-admin-dashboard.png the approval queue's Review column (Approve/Reject) is past the right edge of the scrolling table container, with no visible scroll cue. The page doesn't overflow, so the plan's requirement is met.
findings.action: Consider stacking the review buttons under the title on small screens, or rely on the row link to the detail page, where the actions fit.

findings.label: Manual dev-DB walkthrough not done
findings.detail: Plan D4's manual click-through on :3000 against the dev DB was not performed. phase5-verification.md and the checklist record this honestly; both roles' flows are covered by Playwright against the real API and test DB.
findings.action: Perform it in Phase 6, where the 'Manual end-to-end' checklist item is still open.

findings.label: Status select reached by .focus(), not Tab
findings.detail: The a11y keyboard test focuses the Status trigger programmatically before ArrowDown/Enter, so Tab reachability is not asserted.
findings.action: Tab to the trigger from the search box in the test.
